svg.title: Sizing a round pouch from a charging case
svg.desc: Left: the footprint of a charging case seen from above, 1.9 by 0.9 inches in the example, with its perimeter, 2 times 2.8, which is 5.6 inches. Right: the pouch tube seen from above as a circle around the case. A table shows stitch counts at 4 single crochet per inch: 24 stitches is 6.0 inches around, 27 is 6.75, and 30 is 7.5. The tube must go around the case perimeter plus a little ease, so 27 is the example choice.
svg.text: The tube goes around the case, not across it
24 sts = 6.0 in. Snug by 0.4 in. The lid may scuff going in.
27 sts = 6.75 in. About an inch of ease. Example choice.
30 sts = 7.5 in. Roomy. The case rattles in a soft pouch.
